---
title: "Aakriti's Animint Gallery"
output: html_document
---

```{r echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
# --- CONFIGURATION ---
user <- "aakritixyz"
repos <- c(
  "ten-points-animint", "iris-animint-test", "worldbank-animint-test", 
  "kmeans-animint-test", "mc-sample-mean-test", "buffon-needle-test", 
  "rosling-bubbles-test"
)

# --- THE AUTOMATED LOOP ---
cat('<table style="width:100%; border-collapse: collapse;">')
cat('<thead><tr style="background-color: #eee;"><th>Screenshot</th><th>Project</th><th>Links</th></tr></thead><tbody>')

for(repo in repos){
  # We split the "https" part to trick the Pandoc parser into not adding brackets
  protocol <- "https"
  colon_slashes <- "://"
  
  img  <- paste0(protocol, colon_slashes, "[raw.githubusercontent.com/](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/)", user, "/", repo, "/main/Capture.PNG")
  demo <- paste0(protocol, colon_slashes, user, ".github.io/", repo, "/")
  code <- paste0(protocol, colon_slashes, "[github.com/](https://github.com/)", user, "/", repo)
  
  name <- toupper(gsub("-animint|-test", "", repo))

  # Build the row as a single string
  row <- paste0(
    "<tr>",
    "<td style='padding:10px; border:1px solid #ddd;'><img src='", img, "' width='200'></td>",
    "<td style='padding:10px; border:1px solid #ddd;'><b>", name, "</b></td>",
    "<td style='padding:10px; border:1px solid #ddd;'><a href='", demo, "'>View Demo</a><br><a href='", code, "'>Source Code</a></td>",
    "</tr>"
  )
  cat(row)
}

cat('</tbody></table>')
